subtitle: Expand your rhythmic vocabulary with modern percussive guitar techniques

columns.title: Rhythmic Expansion
columns.text: Percussive techniques transform the guitar into a complete rhythm section, adding drums, bass, and textural elements to traditional playing approaches.

columns.title: Modern Applications
columns.text: Contemporary music demands rhythmic sophistication. Percussive techniques provide the tools for modern acoustic performance and solo arrangements.

cards.title: Rhythmic Integration

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Percussive techniques must integrate musically with melodic and harmonic content. The percussion should enhance rather than compete with the primary musical elements.

items: Percussion on weak beats creates syncopated feel
Strong beat percussion reinforces harmonic rhythm
Subtle percussion adds texture without distraction
Dynamic percussion creates musical shape and climax

cards.title: Timbral Variety

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Different percussive techniques produce various timbres and frequencies. Understanding these colors helps create rich, varied rhythmic textures.

items: High-frequency taps - snare-like, cutting through mix

cards.title: Technical Coordination

fields.label: Content
fields.value: Percussive techniques require coordination between both hands and often integration with traditional playing techniques simultaneously.

items: Left hand continues fretting while right hand adds percussion
Strumming integrates with palm strikes and slaps
Harmonic production combined with percussive release
